description: Source code defining Ginkgo testing framework flags and flag set management, including flag structures, methods for handling flags, and flag argument generation.

classes.name: GinkgoFlag
classes.description: Represents a command-line flag with associated metadata such as name, usage, deprecation info, and export options.

classes.name: GinkgoFlags
classes.description: A slice of GinkgoFlag, with methods for copying, prefixing, and subsetting flags.

classes.name: GinkgoFlagSection
classes.description: Defines a section grouping for flags, including styling and description.

classes.name: GinkgoFlagSections
classes.description: A slice of GinkgoFlagSection with lookup functionality.

classes.name: GinkgoFlagSet
classes.description: Encapsulates a set of flags, their bindings, sections, and the underlying *flag.FlagSet, with methods for parsing, validation, and usage display.

methods.name: CopyAppend
methods.description: Returns a new GinkgoFlags slice with additional flags appended.

methods.name: WithPrefix
methods.description: Returns a new GinkgoFlags slice with each flag's name and deprecated name prefixed.

methods.name: SubsetWithNames
methods.description: Returns a subset of flags matching specified names.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Finds and returns a flag by name from the flag set.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if the GinkgoFlagSet has been initialized.

methods.name: WasSet
methods.description: Determines if a flag was set during parsing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and returns remaining args.

methods.name: ValidateDeprecations
methods.description: Tracks deprecated flags used and issues deprecation messages.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Generates a formatted usage string for the flag set.

methods.name: substituteUsage
methods.description: Outputs the usage string to the flag set output.

methods.name: usageForSection
methods.description: Formats a section header for usage output.

methods.name: usageForFlag
methods.description: Formats a single flag's usage information.

methods.name: usageForGoFlag
methods.description: Formats usage info for a standard Go flag.

methods.name: GenerateFlagArgs
methods.description: Generates command-line argument strings from flags and bindings.
